name: Ben Shapiro
role: American conservative commentator, host of The Ben Shapiro Show, co-founder of The Daily Wire
summary: Orthodox Jewish conservative commentator who defends free markets, limited government, originalist courts and traditional social values, and a hawkish pro-Israel, anti-China foreign policy. He opposes abortion and nationalized health care, supports the death penalty, and is skeptical of climate policy, international institutions and protectionism. He has been a libertarian-leaning critic of drug and marriage laws, while supporting restrictions on illegal and mass immigration.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Opposes Medicare-for-All and nationalized care, arguing it produces rationing, unaffordable costs and weaker drug innovation; wants Obamacare repealed and more supply instead.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Argues minimum-wage hikes reduce low-wage earnings (citing Seattle $15) and push firms to cut jobs or outsource; calls the mandate an artificial wage increase.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Strongly agreed that the freer the market the freer the people; argues government interventions in housing, education and health push prices up.

public-ownership.rationale: Presents nationalization of major industries as the failed socialist model, using Venezuela as the case study; no utility-specific statement.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Strongly agreed on the quiz that the rich are too highly taxed, and dismisses "tax the rich to be fair" as class-warfare sloganeering.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Mixed: accepts environmental rules for externalities but rejects antitrust-style limits on companies and says profit is a firm's main job.

cut-welfare.rationale: Calls entitlement reform the most important thing government could do, sees welfare states as sustainable only in small homogeneous countries, and says people able to work should not expect support.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Disagreed that only wrongdoers need worry about surveillance; his 2013 column says the NSA programs may have stopped attacks but that federal power over personal data is a risk. Mixed.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Says he is libertarian on drugs: marijuana should be decriminalized and drugs that just harm the user are their own business, though PCP-type drugs that cause externalities should stay illegal.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Treats "hate speech" legislation and platform regulation as tools to ban non-woke speech and warns of a court that would allow it.

strong-leader.rationale: Argues that an executive who ignores checks and balances chafes eventually, and says the less Congress does the better; criticizes governing by executive bypass of the legislature.

state-harmful.rationale: Says the government obviously has to provide services such as police and defense, so does not hold that the state is unnecessary.

limit-guns.rationale: Opposes strict limits, saying banning all guns would be unwise and immoral and criticizing gun-control campaigns; supports narrower measures such as school security and enforcement.

empower-police-military.rationale: Opposes defunding police and says non-enforcement of crime fails the public; no explicit call for more military funding or authority.

decide-locally.rationale: Argues that concentrating power in Brussels or Washington maximizes polarization and that local issues belong to states and localities.

rehabilitation.rationale: Agreed punishment should matter more than rehabilitation and strongly agreed rehabilitating some criminals is a waste of time.

traditional-family.rationale: Says marriage exists to produce and rear children with both parents, and that conservatives must rebuild a culture of raising children within traditional morality.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Mixed: morally opposes it, opposed court-imposed recognition and wants the state out of marriage, but in 2019 said his view should have no effect on public policy and that his guest and he agree legally.

abortion-legal.rationale: Strongly agreed abortion should always be illegal when the mother's life is not threatened; calls Roe a legal monstrosity and welcomes state bans.

more-religion-public.rationale: Laments that America is becoming less religious and defends displaying the Ten Commandments publicly.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Says government cannot fix historic inequity and should only ensure equal law; favors private-sector efforts and opposes reparations checks.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Says there are objective measures of male and female and calls the left's gender theories anti-scientific.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Says nations need a shared creed and Western heritage and that multiculturalism has weakened European cultural solidarity.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Says mass migration damages America culturally, and unskilled mass migration economically, but defends skilled legal immigration and favors merit-based admission.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Calls the UN a "wretched hive of scum and villainy," urges defunding it and describes the ICC as an overreach.

free-trade.rationale: Calls himself a free trader who would limit trade only for national security and argues robust international trade underpins prosperity.

nation-first.rationale: Mixed: defends nationalism tied to American values and criticizes internationalism, but also urges strengthened alliances and trade ties.

open-borders.rationale: Attacks the open-borders agenda, says mass migration damages America and that none of his pro-skilled-immigration argument supports unfettered immigration.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Mocks climate alarm, calls the Paris accord meaningless, and said a 4C rise is not an emergency.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Says nuclear power is clean and that unfounded fears have led people to ban it.

central-planning.rationale: Says full employment under top-down control gave "a horrible economy" in the USSR, Cuba and Venezuela.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Calls himself a free trader who would curb trade only for national security; on the quiz called protectionism generally unnecessary; criticized the 2025 tariffs and tariffs on allies.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Describes government direction of industry as corporatism, a progressive-era tradition rather than the free-market right.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Characterizes corporatism, with industries run in concert under central direction, as a plank of the progressive left rather than a free-market position.

one-party-rule.rationale: Strongly disagreed that a one-party state's freedom from debate is an advantage.

separate-church-state.rationale: Defends public display of the Ten Commandments and argues religion should not be pushed out of public view; also says he does not seek theocracy.

military-superiority.rationale: Warns that American retreat from the world stage would empower China and calls China's goal the destruction of America's global dominance.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Says he is not interested in a nation sharing an ethnicity; a nation needs a common creed, and Israel is not ethnically homogeneous.

limit-population.rationale: Ridicules Ehrlich-style population control and the proposal to cut childbearing to protect the planet.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Strongly disagreed that "from each according to his ability to each according to his need" is a good idea.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Says a firm's purpose is profit for shareholders, with employment as an ancillary benefit, and rejects the idea that financial profit-making contributes nothing.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Says there is a truth to be pursued and that subjectivism is no substitute for it.

universal-morality.rationale: Argues that eternal truths exist, rooted in God, and that discarding them for subjectivism is crippling.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Says he believes in Israel as a nation state where Judaism can thrive and be safe, and defends Israel's eternal bond to Jerusalem.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Says deficits impoverish future generations and that spending cuts are needed; on stimulus specifically he criticizes Obama-era deficits.

economic-freedom.rationale: Strongly agreed that the freer the market the freer the people, and describes statism as the road to loss of liberty.

force-without-un.rationale: Strongly agreed that military action defying international law is sometimes justified, calling international law idiotic; supports the 2026 Iran action without UN approval.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Strongly agreed that those able to work who refuse the opportunity should not expect society's support.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Calls for ramping up American oil and gas production, criticizing the administration's green-energy-first policy.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Says nations need a shared creed and that assimilation capacity varies by culture, not ethnicity; does not call for giving up all original culture.

elite-replacement.rationale: Rejects the great replacement theory as a racial conspiracy, while arguing the left sees demographic change as politically useful.

national-mission.rationale: Says patriotism does not mean it is America's job to spread its values everywhere.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Rejects the claim that men benefit from an overarching patriarchy and rape culture, calling the APA's framing nonsense.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Strongly disagreed that people with serious inheritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce, calling it eugenics.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Strongly disagreed with the quiz item that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind, if it refers to race.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Argues America rests on equality of rights and that equal justice under law is the only route to a fair society.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Rejects the view of Israel as a colonial outpost, saying Jewish connection to the land pre-existed everything else.

trade-surplus.rationale: Says if China pursues mercantilist policies "let it," arguing autarky and mercantilism lead to stagnation.

separated-powers.rationale: Argues for checks and balances and for separation of powers as in Scalia's originalism, warning against executives who bypass Congress.

party-controls-media.rationale: Opposes government pressure on social media to suppress "misinformation" and strongly agreed that broadcasters should get no public funding.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Argues the EU's concentration of power in Brussels drove polarization and that the US should learn from it.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Argues the US should deepen alliances with Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and India and criticizes the idea of withdrawing from the world.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Strongly disagreed that there are no savage and civilized cultures, only different ones, citing the Taliban; also says Western civilization is superior.

death-penalty.rationale: Strongly agreed the death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Mixed on the quiz: called pornography a great evil but said it should be legal for adults, noting local government could regulate.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Says it is un-American to override religious belief and objects to religious florists and organizations being forced to take part in what they reject.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Agreed controlling inflation matters more than controlling unemployment; cites Trump's pressure on the Fed to lower rates as fueling inflation worries.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Criticizes presidents who claim they lack authority and then act unilaterally, arguing executives should be bound by law.

ban-cartels.rationale: Disagreed that a free market needs restrictions on predatory multinationals, saying monopolies arise mainly where governments sponsor them.

no-bailouts.rationale: Says none of the corporations bailed out should have been, because of moral hazard.

patriotic-education.rationale: Argues public education exists to produce citizens who uphold the Constitution and laments young Americans' low pride in the country.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: States that meritocracy is by definition opposed to racial preferences and rejects equity-based distribution by race.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Praises the Constitution as a binding legal document protecting speech, religion and arms from reinterpretation by courts.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Lists no-fault divorce laws among government changes that undermined marriage.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Reported by Wikipedia as backing privatization of Social Security; I did not find his own words on it.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Strongly disagreed that land should not be bought and sold, saying the alternative is government ownership and allocation.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Argues that treating unequal outcomes as proof of racism requires no evidence of intent and is idiotic, since all groupings produce differing outcomes.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Presents the left's treatment of consumerism as sin as an old, odd notion rather than a real harm.

non-intervention.rationale: Supports US military action against Iran and defended the Iraq invasion on security grounds; backs Israel's war on Hamas.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: 2013 column calls for getting government out of the business of marriage, leaving it to voluntary contracts; Wikipedia and a 2019 clip show he still holds this.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Says there is no international law and that the UN and ICC lack legitimacy; strongly agreed defying it can be justified.

religion-illusion.rationale: Defends religious belief as a source of eternal truth and warns that its loss leads to new secular idols.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Credits free-market capitalism with the dramatic decrease of poverty and transnational corporations with benefiting humanity more than top-down schemes.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Argues Jewish historic attachment to Jerusalem and the land is the foundation of Israel's legitimacy.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Treats the Holocaust as established history, noting that antisemitism eventually ends in dead bodies, as the Holocaust showed.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Strongly agreed that what consenting adults do in a private bedroom is no business of the state.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Says transgender identity does not change biological sex and rejects the claim that believing you are a woman makes you one.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Says radical Islam is dangerous and large parts of the Muslim world are hostile to Western views on speech and women's rights, while rejecting condemnation of all Muslims.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Urges strengthening security ties with Asian partners against China rather than staying aloof.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Agreed that charity is better than Social Security for helping the disadvantaged, and favors private and religious help over government for historic inequity.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Cites local voting for noncitizens as a failed blue-state idea.

rent-control.rationale: Argues rent control raises housing costs by discouraging development.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Said Kyle Rittenhouse clearly acted in self-defense and should be acquitted.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Says there are objective measures of whether someone is male or female.

free-public-college.rationale: Lists "free" college tuition among the giveaways promised by Sanders and Warren, which he mocks as spending other people's money.

public-service-media.rationale: Strongly agreed that no broadcasting institution, however independent, should receive public funding.

voter-id.rationale: Says concerns about voter fraud are far better supported than claims of voter suppression about the Georgia election law.

premarital-sex.rationale: Strongly agreed that sex outside marriage is usually immoral.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Calls the ICC an ill-begotten institution that "beclowned itself" and says there is no consensus behind international criminal law.

close-ties-china.rationale: Calls China America's enemy, not a rival, and urges containment through ties with its neighbors.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Argues systemic racism claims rest on disparate outcomes rather than evidence; Wikipedia reports he sees no widespread systemic injustice today.

notes: Mostly mature positions from 2017-2026. Some answers rest on a March 2020 political-compass quiz he read aloud, which may predate later shifts. On same-sex marriage he opposed court-imposed recognition and wanted the state out of marriage (2013), and said in 2019 that his moral view should not shape policy; scored 0 as contested. Early columns (2007) were written as a teenager and were used only where later material agrees.
